description: Implement chronological sorting for threads in the sidebar based on their creation time. Currently threads appear in an unspecified order, but they should be displayed from newest to oldest to provide better context about conversation flow. This change should apply consistently across all thread displays in the sidebar interface.
functional_requirements: Sort threads in descending order by creation timestamp (newest first)
Apply the sorting consistently across all thread list views in the sidebar
Ensure the sorting logic works with existing thread filtering and search functionality
Maintain thread grouping and categorization while applying chronological ordering
Update any related UI components that display thread lists to use the new sorting
Preserve thread selection and navigation behavior after implementing the sorting change
